To your left you'll see a white sofa, walk towards this white sofa. To your left you'll see a large opening to another room and a white table in the middle. Walk towards this white table. And look towards the left you can see a white bench with some pillows on it, walk towards this bench. And to the left you'll see a door that's open walk towards this door. And to the right you'll see a stairway, go up the first two stairs. Once you're standing on the first two stairs you've reached the end.
